d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap, ekdam perfect, thick aur yummy Cafe Style Cold Coffee Banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, aap bhi try karna, without any syrup or base powder, ye homemade instant cold coffee best banti hai at home, sahi proportions share kar raha hu :)
Ingredients:
for 2 glass cold coffee
Ice cubes - 6-8 pcs (3/4 glass)
Milk - 1 glass (cow milk acha rahega)
Sugar - 4 tsp
Coffee Instant Powder - 2 tsp (or 2 shots of espresso)
Milk Powder - 2 tbsp
